podcast.title: "Eleanor Rigby" Cover Notoriety
podcast.body: Miles and Taipei Houston first gained attention when his father posted a clip of them performing a hard and heavy rendition of The Beatles' "Eleanor Rigby." "They first found some notoriety when dad posted a clip of them doing a hard and heavy version of the Beatles Eleanor Rigby."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Son of Lars Ulrich
podcast.body: Miles Ulrich is one of Lars Ulrich's sons and plays drums for the band Taipei Houston. "Miles is the drummer and Lane, whose three years younger sings in place bass."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
